confirmation.rule: anytime-valid one-sided Hoeffding confidence-sequence lower bound, strict L > tau
confirmation.scope: per-test, time-uniform; not family-wise across the pool

planning.trajectory: s~(m) = s + m*q, n~(m) = n + m (planning-only, real-valued)
planning.m_star: min{ 1 <= m <= m_cap : L_plan(s + m*q, n + m) > tau }, inf if none
planning.fallback: ScoreCost ordering with posterior-MEAN rate (q / mean_cost) when all m* are infinite
planning.cache: per-arm dirty cache; m* recomputed only after that arm executes

budgets.semantics: fraction of the total recorded execution time of the benchmark

amini_transfuser.sampling: without replacement within each route pool

sensodat_replay.prior: source-trained HGB, Beta(1 + kappa*pi, 1 + kappa*(1 - pi)), kappa = 5
